title: Kuroda GT Carrot: Characteristics
metaDescription: Kuroda GT carrot is an open pollinated carrot variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Kuroda GT carrot is an open pollinated carrot variety. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor brand).

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Kuroda GT carrot is grown

blocks.text: The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [carrot variety finder](/crop-varieties/carrot), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).
Key facts about Kuroda GT carrot

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources
rows: Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: harvest about 100 days after sowing. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit carrot fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** Harvest about 100 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Root: large deep orange roots of about 150 g under vigorous tops.
Rated intermediate against powdery mildew and blight.

blocks.text: These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual carrot on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Kuroda GT carrot

Carrot is a highland crop in the Philippines. Pick a root length your soil can hold: short types for heavy soil. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.a: Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Kuroda GT?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
